well.note: Wellbeing (TODO L1-L8, design document 5.1b). Six parameters from 0 to 1, each 0.5 at the start and frozen at 0.5 until `fromChapter`. Every question each one moves `down` / `up` towards its target. A target is `floor` plus what the farm gives: `stat` (the sum of that key in the effects.add of the things that are built), `dishes` x the number of different dishes among the last `dishWindow` eaten, `ranks` x the skill ranks, `friend` x the friends made, `reputation` x the village's reputation level, `load` x the load of the farm (negative: a busy farm is less calm). Outputs: the energy maximum x (dialLow + dialSpan x (food + strength) / 2), the energy per Rest answer x (dialLow + dialSpan x sleep), and an energy change per question = boost - drain, drain = load x (1 - mood)^2 x maxDrainSums x (energy per Rest answer), mood = mean of friends, calm and play. The drain stops at zero energy. Load = x / (x + loadHalf), x = patches + 2 x animals + 2 x the levels of producing buildings.

party.note: A party at the farm: three dishes from the store are shared, energy is spent, play, friends and calm jump up (and sink back at the usual pace); once in `cooldown` questions. Opened by the card Play and music.

messages: {name} shows you the garden. You eat warm bread on the doorstep and laugh until your tummy hurts.
{name} plays a tune on the porch. You clap along and nobody counts anything.
{name} gives you a seat by the fire and a big mug. For a while you just sit.
visit.note: A friend invites you now and then (`chance` per question, one invitation at a time, from the first friend): a visit costs `energy` and one question (like the walk to the village) and gives nothing back at once, only the bump.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.hint: A good bed, a pillow, a warm hearth.

strength.name: Strength
strength.hint: Practise: every skill rank makes you stronger.

calm.name: Calm
calm.hint: A busy farm is a worry. Quiet things help.

play.name: Play
play.hint: Music, drawing, a party, a visit.
